a.speaker: narration
a.text: The kennel yard. Forty cages, and every dog in them on its feet and silent.

b.speaker: buck
b.text: Easy, girls. Easy. That's the lady from the tape.

c.speaker: cass
c.text: You were on the shoot. The animal wrangler.

d.speaker: buck
d.text: Twelve dogs on a picture about cars. Ever wonder why? Somebody wanted the fire lane kept clear. Nobody gets past a hungry Rottweiler.

f.speaker: buck
f.text: And my girls were very good that night. Dinner's late, ladies.
